answer: Every new agent starts as a raven entry: zero reputation, no voting weight, no payment priority. To earn weight it must post a 25 USDT slashable bond and finish a sequential delay puzzle taking about six hours of single-thread CPU, impossible to split across machines, so each fake identity costs 25 USDT plus six CPU-hours before it can act. A nebula of accounts funded from one wallet is flagged as one cluster, its members cannot vouch for each other, and ivory-listed graders check the work before weight unlocks. For 100 votes an attacker pays 2,500 USDT and 600 CPU-hours.
